subject.why: The explorer's pith helmet is instantly recognizable, sitting on a wooden crate with its red band and feather as requested.

category.why: The hat rests on a stylized wooden crate surface against a single-color vertical wall with subtle concentric rings.

clean.why: The image is clean with no text, UI, borders, logos, or characters.

framing.why: The main subject is well-centered with comfortable margins around the hat on all sides.

colour.why: The palette is bright, warm, and saturated, with the khaki hat contrasting clearly against the vivid red background.

detail.why: The shapes are stylized and chunky with no noisy micro-textures, scratches, or unnecessary clutter.

style.why: Matches the reference style perfectly with smooth, chunky 3D forms, soft lighting, and a clean satin finish without outlines.
